chromium.coverage: Chromium URL events only. Node, extension host, child processes, DNS and OS traffic require separate capture.

artifact: Minified Linux x64, 98b5fa8 plus this checkpoint source
profile: Fresh disposable profile; built-ins enabled; no installed third-party extensions
scope: First 180 seconds of process-tree snapshots; completed Chromium NetLog spans normal launch through normal quit. Search actions happened after socket sampling ended.
limitations: Snapshots can miss short-lived sockets/processes, startup races, unconnected UDP/DNS or inaccessible owners; Chromium omits Node/native transports. No packet/payload audit or universal zero-network assertion.
